meta_title: Ben Tebby Tree & Landscaping | Arborist Birmingham
meta_description: Ben Tebby Tree and Landscaping Services in Birmingham. Expert tree surgery, hedge trimming, and garden landscaping. Free quotes, fully insured. Call 07581 094528.
hero_subhead: Dangerous trees, overgrown hedges, or a complete garden redesign — we handle it all safely and on time.
services_heading: Complete Tree & Garden Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From emergency storm damage and tree removal to hedge laying and full landscape design, we deliver safe, professional results every time.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of dangerous, dead, or unwanted trees using modern rigging equipment. We clear the site completely and recycle waste timber where possible.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Crown Work
services.desc: Crown thinning, reduction, and deadwood removal to restore tree health and improve light. All work carried out to BS 3998 standards.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Split trunks, fallen branches, or uprooted trees? We respond quickly to make the area safe and haul away debris.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Laying
services.desc: Annual hedge cuts, formal topiary, and traditional hedge laying to maintain boundaries and boost wildlife habitat.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Professional stump removal below ground level. The area is left ready for planting or paving without unsightly remnants.

services.title: Garden Landscaping Design
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts combining hard landscaping, planting schemes, and drainage solutions. We build lasting outdoor spaces tailored to your vision.

about_pullquote: I started this because I love trees and hate seeing them butchered by cowboys.
about_para_1: Ben Tebby established this business nearly two decades ago after seeing too many trees damaged by poor practice. What began as a one-man operation out of Rouncil Farm has grown into a respected arboricultural practice serving Birmingham and the surrounding Midlands. Ben holds full arboricultural qualifications and membership with the Arboricultural Association, ensuring every job meets industry standards.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on a simple promise: arrive on time, do the job right, and leave your garden tidier than we found it. We reinvest in the best equipment and training so you never need to worry about safety or quality. Repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals make up the vast majority of our work — that's the trust we've earned.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had three massive oaks that needed taking down. Ben and the lads made light work of it — really professional, no mess left behind. Fair price too. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Martin C.

reviews.text: Storm took down a huge beech tree across our drive. Called Ben on a Saturday morning and he had a crew here by afternoon. Cleared everything by end of day. Legend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Ben and his team completely redesigned our rear garden. They listened to what we wanted, advised on the plants, built a proper retaining wall, and the landscaping looks stunning. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Richard P.
